chunks: Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā narrated to me from his father, from Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Mālik ibn ‘Aťiyyah, from his father, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:

When you take from the clay of the Oppressed One and place it in your mouth, recite: O Allāh! I ask You through the right of this dust, through the right of the angel who held it, through the right of the Prophet who embraced it, and through the right of the Imam who is buried in it to send Your blessing on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad, and to allow it to be a beneficial cure and an extensive sustenance for me, and (allow it) to be my protection against any fear and disease. Verily if you recite disease. Verily if you recite this, Allāh will cure you and bestow you with good health.

key_terms.تُرْبَةِ الْمَظْلُومِ: Clay/dust of the Oppressed One (referring to Imam Husain)

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication to recite when eating the dust of Imam Husain's grave?
ai.summary: This narration from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the Shia practice of *turbat al-imam* (consuming clay from the Imam's grave) as a means of spiritual and physical healing, linking the supplicant directly to the cosmic hierarchy of the Angel, Prophet, and Imam. The specific invocation invokes the 'right' (*haqq*) of the dust, reflecting the theological concept that the physical remnants of the Imams carry divine authority and intercessory power. This practice underscores the Shia belief in the tangible connection between the believer and the Ahl al-Bayt, transforming a simple act of consumption into a profound ritual of seeking refuge and sustenance.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā narrated to me from his father, from Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Mālik ibn ‘Aťiyyah, from his father, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:

When you take from the clay of the Oppressed One (Imam Ḥusain (a.s.)) and place it in your mouth, recite (the following):                                     O Allāh! I ask You through the right of this dust, through the right of the angel who held it, through the right of the Prophet who embraced it, and through the right of the Imam who is buried in it to send Your blessing on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad, and to allow it to be a beneficial cure and an extensive sustenance for me, and (allow it) to be my protection against any fear and disease. Verily if you recite this, Allāh will cure you and bestow you with good health.
